column1: # coupling-census-map.tsv: every row of the coupling census and what disposes of it.
# Read by .github/scripts/coupling-check.sh --coverage (never in CI: the census is private).
# Census ids: E, T, D and H rows keep the census's own labels; the unlabelled rows are numbered
# in document order per pass (CD daemon, CE envoy, CT tooling; CT-074 to CT-477 are the contract
# fixtures continuation and CT-478 to CT-493 the machine recordings continuation, which replace
# the census's two summary rows). Masking changed one site's text: E08's file is
# scripts/e2e/parked-decision-devbox.sh, which the census prints with a masked host name.
# Dispositions: table:<row ids>; private-names-lane (the lane that owns the leak check and
# every name on the private-name list); kind-B:<exact path or record directory>; product:<reason>.
